name: Mara Vos
desire: keep the station honest and get the fault fixed by the book
need: to stop atoning, without knowing it, for a silence she never chose
values: a mercy she would not say aloud
fears: being the one who lets people die through correctness
being the one who lets them die through cowardice
contradictions: reveres the log yet is about to withhold from it
wants rules to protect the weak and suspects they are killing them
beliefs: the record is the only thing that outlasts an operator
constraints: alone on the station most of the watch
no authority to re-survey the chart
